texts.en:
We have found signs of water all over this world. For all we know, it should still be here. The temperatures are within the normal range for liquid water to exist, and there is still an atmosphere, albeit tenuous. And yet, everything here is dry and what vegetation exists is parched.

In addition, scans have revealed traces of another spacefaring civilization on the planet. The archaeological team will have two goals: find out what happened to the water and understand what other spacefarers have been doing here. Most hypotheses are already linking the two and some in the team believe that this might have been the work of 'water thieves'.

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上发现了充满蘑菇的巨大峡谷，这就是答案的开始。原来水在这些蘑菇里面。它们似乎扩张到了星球表面的很大一部分，并且都与同一个菌丝体相连，因此从技术上讲，它算是一个单一的有机体，也是我们见过的最大的有机体之一。该团队的一些成员将这种巨大的真菌称为“巨大蘑菇”。

看起来蘑菇已经过基因改造，并完全接管了曾经存在于这里的生态系统。它们肆无忌惮地加速生长，以至于它们吸收了这里存在的大部分水。随后，它们进入了一种干枯的休眠状态，在这种状态下，大部分真菌仍然活着，水遍布整个生物体。
texts.en:
The discovery on [From.Planet.GetName] of vast canyons filled with mushrooms provided us with the beginning of an answer. The water is inside the mushrooms. They seem to span a large part of the surface of the world, all connected to the same mycelium, which technically makes it a single organism, and one of the biggest we've ever seen. Some of the members of the team dubbed this humongous fungus the 'Fumongus'.

It looks like the mushrooms have been genetically altered and have completely taken over the ecosystem that once existed here. Their unbridled and accelerated growth was such that they absorbed most of the water that was present here. They subsequently entered a sort of dried-up dormant state in which most of the fungus is still alive, with water spread out across the whole organism.

texts.zh:
在坐落在[From.Planet.GetName]峡谷中的菌丝森林的深处，我们发现了某种地堡，早已被蘑菇摧垮。该团队认为，它是由对这里的蘑菇进行基因改造的那个物种建造的。

地堡的大部分已经倒塌，其中的许多设备可能已经损坏无法修复，但我们已经确定了一些可能装有可利用材料的密封房间。值得注意的是，这里没有发现外星人遗骸。也许他们放弃了这个地方，也或者全部被当地野生动物所吸收了。
texts.en:
Deep in the heart of the mycelial forests nestled in the canyons of [From.Planet.GetName] we discovered some sort of bunker, long overrun by mushrooms. The team believes that it was built by the same species that genetically altered the mushrooms here. 

Large sections of the bunker have collapsed and a lot of the equipment within it is likely broken beyond repair, but we have identified some sealed rooms that might hold exploitable material. Notably, no alien remains have been found here. Maybe they abandoned the place, or else didn't leave behind any body parts that weren't absorbed by the local wildlife.

texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的地堡用于保护计算设备，其中一些似乎直接连接到菌丝体。值得庆幸的是，我们设法重新激活了几个终端和数据库。

破解加密和解密所使用的语言需要时间，团队已要求派我们的几位顶级[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]来帮忙。
texts.en:
The bunker on [From.Planet.GetName] was used to protect computing equipment, some of which appears to be directly connected to the mycelium. Thankfully, we managed to reactivate several terminals and databanks.

Breaking the encryption and deciphering the language used will take time, and the team has requested that several of our top [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] be sent here to help.

texts.zh:
我们从[From.Planet.GetName]地堡中的数据库中找到了有价值的信息。数据库告诉我们，这是一种监听哨站。显然，外星人找到了一种方法来解释通过菌丝体传播的信号并将它们转化为可操作的情报。

我们不明白这怎么实现的，但该团队现在将尝试从附近的冰小行星带运水过来再次“唤醒”巨大蘑菇，看看如果它有传输数据的话，传输的是什么样的数据。
texts.en:
We have recovered valuable information from the databanks found in the bunker on [From.Planet.GetName]. The databanks tell us that this was a sort of listening post. Apparently, the aliens found a way to interpret the signals coursing through the mycelium and convert them into actionable intel.

We do not understand how this might have been possible, but the team will now try to bring water from nearby ice asteroids to 'awaken' the Fumongus again and see what kind data it transmits, if any.

texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的蘑菇又开始繁茂了。在其他几艘飞船的帮助下，我们不得不将几颗冰小行星拖入轨道，然后将其中的大块降落到行星上的各个地方进行融化。这是一个漫长的过程，但它终于开始有结果了。

有了这个，计算机开始吐出看起来非常随机的小块数据，直到我们从母星上分辨出信号。与[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的团队进行了一系列合作实验，唯一可能的结论是蘑菇对其他星球上发生的事情的有有限的了解。虽然我们检索到的数据尚不可利用，但预计继续尝试恢复蘑菇会给我们带来更多结果。
texts.en:
The mushrooms on [From.Planet.GetName] are starting to flourish again. With the help of several other ships, we had to tow several icy asteroids into orbit before bringing down chunks of them to various places on the planet to melt. It has been long process, but it is finally beginning to bear fruit.

With this, the computers began to spit out small bits of data that seemed pretty random until we recognized activity from our home. In cooperation with teams on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], a series of experiments has been conducted and the only possible conclusion is that the mushroom has some limited awareness of what happens on other planets. While the data we have retrieved is not exploitable just yet, continued efforts to restore the mushrooms are expected to give us more results.

texts.zh:
菌丝体监听阵列终于可以运行了。已经从轨道上带来了大量的水来满足一直很渴的蘑菇，并且对计算资源进行了重大升级。

然而，关于菌丝网络，我们仍然知之甚少。考虑到所传达的信息量，穿越网络的信号数量出人意料地低。最重要的理论假设巨大蘑菇存在于跨维度，在这些维度的距离与我们的习惯不同。
在任何情况下，巨大蘑菇都可以与它跨越星系的后代接触，这些较小的殖民地能够传递数据，我们可以解析这些数据。 但是还有谁可以访问这个网络呢？有很多数据我们无法与这个星系中的恒星系相关联。我们更悲观的 [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] 认为我们可能不是唯一在倾听的人，通过重新激活网络，我们只是向使用它的所有人展示了我们自己。

鉴于我们仍然不了解巨大蘑菇，以及之前接触过它的物种，最好不要管它。
texts.en:
The Mycelium Listening Array is finally operational. A significant supply of water has been brought from orbit to sate the ever-thirsty mushroom, and major upgrades have been made to the computing resources.

And yet, there is still so much we don't know about the mycelial network.  The number of signals traversing the network proved surprisingly low, considering the quantity of information conveyed. The most prominent theory posits that the Fumongus exists across dimensions where distances are not what we are used to.
In any case, the Fumongus is in contact with its offspring across the galaxy, and these smaller colonies are able to relay data, which we can then interpret. But who else may have access to this network? There is a lot of data that we were not able to correlate to systems in this galaxy. Our more pessimistic [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] argue we might not be the only ones listening, and that by reactivating the network we just revealed ourselves to anyone using it.

Given all we still don't know about the Fumongus, or about the previous species that tapped into it, it might be best to just leave it alone..

label.zh: 偏执的傻瓜。我们该使用它。
能监听还能汇报。也许我们也可以学学类似的事情。
label.en: Monitor and report. Perhaps we can learn something similar.

texts.zh:
菌丝体监听阵列终于可以运行了。已经从轨道上带来了大量的水来满足一直很渴的蘑菇，并且对计算资源进行了重大升级。

仍然存在一些谜团，毕竟我们仍然不确定蘑菇是如何设法从星系其他地方收集这么多数据的。考虑到所传达的信息量，穿越网络的信号数量出人意料地低。最重要的理论假设巨大蘑菇存在于跨维度，在这些维度的距离与我们的习惯不同。
在任何情况下，巨大蘑菇都可以与它跨越星系的后代接触，这些较小的殖民地能够传递数据，我们可以解析这些数据。

随着网络再次运行，剩下的唯一决议就是是否将其用于监视。
texts.en:
The Mycelium Listening Array is finally operational. A significant supply of water has been brought from orbit to sate the ever-thirsty mushroom, and major upgrades have been made to the computing resources.

Some mysteries remain, as we are still not sure how the mushroom manages to collect that much data from the rest of the galaxy. The number of signals traversing the network proved surprisingly low, considering the quantity of information conveyed. The most prominent theory posits that the Fumongus exists across dimensions where distances are not what we are used to.
In any case, the Fumongus is in contact with its offspring across the galaxy, and these smaller colonies are able to relay data, which we can then interpret.

With the network working again, the only decision left to make is whether to use it for surveillance, or not.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行的探险扰乱了一些当地野生动物腐烂的茧壳，它们现在似乎受到寄生真菌的影响。这些真菌僵尸立即开始袭击我们，显然是被我们营地和我们身体内部的水源所吸引。

僵尸们在被我们的安全团队把它们烧光之前迅速地杀死了[dead_scientist.GetName]。干枯的遗骸就是他们遗留下来的全部了。
texts.en:
The expedition carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] has disturbed the decaying husks of some local wildlife, which seem now to be under the sway of parasitic fungi. These fungal zombies immediately began assaulting us, apparently drawn to sources of water in our camp and inside our very bodies.

The zombies made short work of [dead_scientist.GetName] before they could be burned down by our security team. Their desiccated remains are all that is left of them.

在被[Root.GetLeaderName]阻止之前，僵尸设法杀死了几个 [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]。当我们试图找回他们时，他们干枯的尸体已经变成碎片。

The zombies managed to kill several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] before they could be stopped by [Root.GetLeaderName] Their desiccated corpses fell to pieces when we tried to recover them.

These fungal zombies immediately began assaulting us, apparently drawn to sources of water in our camp and inside our very bodies.

Luckily, [Root.GetLeaderName] and the nearby security escort managed to neutralize the zombies before they could seriously injure anyone.

The expedition carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] has disturbed the decaying husks of some local wildlife, which seem now to be under the sway of parasitic fungi. # 脱水 / Desiccated

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/00_base_game_arc_sites.txt:140；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt:9393；common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:1698 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics（初始化器要求 has_ancrel） · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

遗址权重为0，由星系初始化器 fumongus_init_01 在拥有《远古遗物》时创建（common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:1698）：一颗干涸的、长满蘑菇的星球。

Weight 0: created by the system initializer fumongus_init_01 when Ancient Relics is present (common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:1698): a parched world covered in mushrooms.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

水都被一整株巨大的菌丝体“巨蕈”吸走；星球上有另一个航天文明的掩体，里面的“菌丝监听阵列”可以把菌丝网络的信号转成情报。考古队需要拖来冰小行星为蘑菇补水，才能让阵列运转。

1. 囤水者：满是蘑菇的峡谷与一整株相连的菌丝体
2. 被摧垮的地堡：被蘑菇占满的掩体
3. 真菌改造者：掩体里的计算设备直接连着菌丝（物理学研究）
4. 从蘑菇到代码：数据库显示这是一座监听站：外星人能解读菌丝信号
5. 不再干燥：拖来冰小行星浇灌蘑菇，60天后阵列上线（隐藏事件 ancrel.13125 按旗标分派）

All the water is held by one gigantic mycelium, the "Fumongus"; a bunker of another spacefaring species holds a "Mycelium Listening Array" that turns network signals into intel. The team must tow icy asteroids in to water the mushroom before the array works.

1. Water Hoarders: canyons of mushrooms forming one organism
2. Overrun Bunker: a bunker overrun by mushrooms
3. Fungal Tamperers: computing equipment wired directly to the mycelium (physics research)
4. From Shroom to Code: the databanks show a listening post that decodes mycelial signals
5. Dry No More: icy asteroids are brought to water it; 60 days later the array is online (hidden ancrel.13125 dispatches by flag)

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 敬畏这个远古蘑菇 / Fear the Old Shroom：“敬畏古蕈”：若国家已有 fumongus_colony_complete（colony.2075 设置，同时给星球加“真菌研究区”资源点）则显示此版本；a 使用它（团结奖励、修正“菌丝网络”、20年“专制”修正、设置 fumongus_* 全局标志）；b 任其生长；演化猎手有专属选项 / shown when the country already has fumongus_colony_complete (set by colony.2075, which also adds the fungal study zone); a use it (unity reward, modifier mycelial_network_modifier, a 20-year authoritarian modifier, fumongus_* global flags); b leave it; Evolutionary Predators have their own option
- 巨大蘑菇又在倾听了 / The Fumongus Listens Again：“巨蕈又在倾听了”：没有该旗标时的版本，选项相同（启动监控/任其生长） / the version without that flag, with the same options (start monitoring / leave it)
- 专属池 site_fumongus_random_events（总权重190）：敌对野生动物8090–8093（5/25/25/25）、真菌僵尸8300–8315（5/25/25/25，其中8315 消耗食物100）、资源贮藏点8040（权重30）。 / Own pool site_fumongus_random_events (total weight 190): hostile wildlife 8090-8093 (5/25/25/25), fungal zombies 8300-8315 (5/25/25/25; 8315 costs 100 food), resource cache 8040 (weight 30).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用本遗址专属的事件池 site_fumongus_random_events。 / Failed rolls draw from this site's own pool site_fumongus_random_events.
